*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the
social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20
(https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf).

Please note that members of the public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council Meeting
of October 20, 2020, at 2:00 P.M. for open session as follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for
  consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority (Legislative Body)
  by sending them to the City Clerk/Secretary at yhorton@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk
  aphillips@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to
  consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00 A.M. the day of the meeting, and
  in the body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence
  should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 A.M. and prior to
  the close of the public hearings, will be made part of the official public record of the meeting.
  Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

  2.  By Telephone-Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments: Members of the public
  can participate in the meeting by telephone to listen and make comments noting the following:

  l The conference begins at 1:30 p.m., Pacific Time, and all interested parties may join the conference 5
  minutes prior.
  l If you are dialing in from a cell phone, please call from an area with good reception. Calls from
  landline phones are highly recommended.
  l If you are watching the meeting via Facebook Live or Channel 35 while also accessing the phone line,
  it is requested that you mute the sound of your video feed as it is delayed from the phone
  transmission. Additionally, when you are making public comments on the phone line, you will be
  inaudible due to feedback.
  l Dial-In: 1-888-251-2949 or 1-215-861-0694 using the specific access codes detailed below for the
  respective City Council Dates:
  ¡ October 6, 2020 - Access Code: 3589734#
  ¡ October 13, 2020 - Access Code: 3889103#
  ¡ October 20, 2020 – Access Code: 1995402#
  ¡ October 27, 2020 – Access Code: 2592670#

  3.  Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:

  l  On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your cable provider
  for details.
  l Live on-line through Facebook Live, with audio and limited video, at
  https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/. All participants viewing and listening to the meeting via
  Facebook Live, must adhere to the Rules of Decorum posted on the City’s Facebook page.

The above access options provide the public with the opportunity to both observe and listen to the meeting;
however, members of the public who wish to orally address the Legislative Body must use the public access
options 1 and 2 noted above.

October 20, 2020

  Inglewood, California
  October 20, 2020

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
  October 20, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
  hour of 2:00 p.m.

  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
  presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts/Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
  follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
  item on the Agendas other than the Public Hearing.

  Billion (Last Name Unknown), Member of the African Town Coalition, spoke regarding
  Agenda Item Nos. 2, letters from the City Attorney’s Office recommending the rejection
  of claims, and 4, re-approval of the use of Assets Forfeiture Funds.

  Ivan (Last Name Unknown), District 1 resident, commented on the overall good job and
  impact this City Council is making.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4 resident, spoke regarding the Warrants and Bills.

  Yvonne Horton, Inglewood City Clerk, read correspondence received via email from an
  Inglewood resident, District 1, regarding Warrants and Bills.

142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Padilla that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  October 15, 2020, in the amount of $2,784,970.76 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/
  Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  Mayor Butts left the Council Chambers at the hour of 2:16 p.m.

  1
   October 20, 2020

131  PUBLIC HEARING HELD – RESOLUTION NO. 21-13 ADOPTED –
  SUBSTANTIAL AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020-2021 ANNUAL
  ACTION PLAN. The City Clerk announced the next scheduled matter was a public
  hearing to consider the adoption of a resolution adopting a substantial amendment to the
  Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Annual Action Plan for the receipt of CARES Act Round 3
  funding from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, and that notices
  were given in the time, form and manner as required by law, an affidavit is on file, and
  communications were received.

  Artie Fields, City Manager presented the staff report dated October 20, 2020

  Robert Chavez, Housing Manager, gave a brief oral report.

  Council Member Morales inquired if there were any person that wished to address the
  City Council on this matter.

  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk, read correspondence received via email signed by the
  following in support of the CARES Act CDBG-CF Round 3 Funding Ana Morall, Juan
  Zavala, Tony Crutchfield and Lester Santos.

  Following the discussion, it was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by
  Council Member Franklin that the City Council does hereby adopt Resolution No. 21-13
  entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA ADOPTING A SUBSTANTIAL AMENDMENT TO THE
  FISCAL YEAR 2020-2021 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN FOR RECEIPT OF
  CARES ACT CDBG-CV ROUND 3 FUNDING FROM THE U.S.
  DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin;
  Noes:  None; and
  Absent: Mayor Butts.

  Mayor Butts returned to City Council Chambers at the hour 2:18 p.m.

132  CLAIMS DENIED. Letters from the Office of the City Attorney recommending the
  following:
  A. Reject the following claims filed pursuant to Government Code Section 913:
  1) Roberto Benitez for alleged property damage; excavation on May 30, 2020.
  2) Willie Hampton for alleged tire damage; debris on September 22, 2020.
  3) Donald Penn for alleged road condition; metal plates on September 5, 2020.
  4) Ronald Rome for alleged tire damage; road condition on September 22, 2020.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, seconded by Council Member Morales, that
  the City Council does hereby reject the claims listed as A1through A4. The motion was
  carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

101  AGREEMENT NO. 20-020 APPROVED – S2K MANAGEMENT; RESOLUTION
  NO. 21-14 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2020-2021 BUDGET.
  Staff report dated October 20, 2020, was presented approval of an Advance Funds
  Agreement with S2K Management, Inc., for costs associated with an environmental
  review of a hotel proposal at 4041-4055 Century Boulevard.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Morales
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Agreement No. 20-020 in the amount of
  $5,312 and; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 20-14 entitled:

  2
   October 20, 2020

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  AMENDING THE 2020-2021 ANNUAL BUDGET TO A THIRD-PARTY
  PEER REVIEW OF THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT
  DOCUMENTS RELATED TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF A PROPOSED 142-
  ROOM HOTEL LOCATED AT 4041-4055 CENTURY BOULEVARD.

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

178  RE-APPROVAL OF USE OF ASSET FORFEITURE FUNDS – NOT APPROVED.

  This Item was pulled from the Agenda.

103  PAYMENT OF OUTSTANDING INVOICES AUTHORIZED - RICHARD
  ATKINS; RESOLUTION NO. 21-15 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL
  YEAR 2020-2021 BUDGET. Staff report dated October 20, 2020, was presented
  recommending authorization to pay an outstanding invoice submitted by Richard Atkins
  dba TDPSTL for the provision of plans for the City of Inglewood Residential Sound
  Insulation Program.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Authorize payment in the amount of $28,199.12; and 2)
  Adopt Resolution No. 20-15 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE 2020-2021 ANNUAL BUDGET

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby approve Agreement No. 21 – 082. The motion was
  carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

126  REPORTS – CITY CLERK. Yvonne Horton, City Clerk, read an email that was
  received for the public comment. Mr. Hammon, an Inglewood resident, commended the
  City Council for their work on the stadium project.

  PUBLIC REMARKS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on any matter connected with City business not
  elsewhere considered on the Agenda.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4, requested the City Council to allow more time for public
  speaking.

  Speaker (Name Unknown) commented meetings are inaccessible to the working class
  people who need to speak on issues like the CARES funding.

  Speaker (Name Unknown) requested the City Council expand the City’s COVID-19
  relief program.

  Ivan (Last Name Unknown) commented on the great job the City Council is doing.

  Speaker (Name Unknown) spoke regarding the Inglewood Police Department.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in memory of Eloy Morales, Sr., father of Council Member Eloy Morales, at
  the hour of 2:37 p.m.

  3
 October 20, 2020

  Approved this ______day of ___________, 2021

  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
